en: A vintage multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard with scalloped edges. It shows several small photographs arranged around a larger central image of a modernist multi‑storey white building set among tall pine trees and landscaped grounds. Other views include swans on a lake, forested park scenes, a ruin or monument, a church tower, and various buildings that look like sanatoriums or resort facilities. In the center bottom, there is a cursive inscription in Latvian.
